text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Coroners (Records Retention) Regulations 2012.

heading.en: Prescribed period for preservation of medical records, etc.

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 8(1) of the Act, the prescribed period is 6 years commencing from the time of death of any person occurring on or after 20 April 2012.

heading.en: Types and form of records and documents to be retained
